This folder and subfolders contains various extension codes.  
You are welcome to contribute to these tools! Once you have new tool that can useful also for other users, please send it to us or use merge request functionality.  

Codes:  
* `post-processing-wf/`: various codes that can be used for processing of wave-functions generated by st codes. 
* `post-processing-qpe/`: various codes that can be used for processing of quasiparticle energies obtained by td codes. 
* `post-processing-td/`: various codes that can be used for processing of data from td runs.
* `sldae/`: tools for generating SLDAE type functionals.
* `vortex-tracking/`: tools for tracking of quantum vortices.
* `parse-input-template.c`: This file demonstrate how to parse input file.
* `extend-dataset-template.c`: This file provides template of code that adds new variable to existing w-dataset.
* `st-test-external-potentials.c`: This file provides simple code that can be used for testing of correctness of implementation of external potentials. 
* `solve-uniform.c`:  This code solves uniform problem according settings from input file. It can be used for checking of correctness of solver parameters.
* `compare-datasets.c`: This tool compares two different datasets and creates a new dataset where differences of all variables are saved. 
* `interpolate-dataset.c`: This code converts existing wdata set into new one defined on lattice with different resolution. Use this code to learn how to use interpolation routines. 
* `resize-dataset.c`: This tool increases dimensionality of wdata set. Use this code to learn how to use resize routines. 
* `vdetect-simple-2d.cpp`, vdetect-simple-2d.c: A simple code for tracking the vortex position in 2d.
